C(G) =& \max_D V(G,D) \nonumber \\
      =& \mathbb{E}_{\bm{x} \sim p_\text{data}}[\log D^*_G(\bm{x})] + \mathbb{E}_{\bm{z} \sim p_{\bm{z}}}[\log (1 - D^*_G(G(\bm{z})))] \\
